name: @deepseaxx/koishi-plugin-message-capsule
description: Turn a replied message or merged record into TXT, JSON, Markdown, PNG, group files, or a text-only forward with customizable templates.

scripts.prepublishOnly: tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --external:koishi --outfile=lib/index.js

description.en: Turn replied messages or merged records into TXT, JSON, Markdown, PNG, files, or text-only forwards with customizable templates. OneBot getForwardMsg is fully supported; other adapters can work when they expose standard expanded forward elements.
description.zh: 把被回复的消息或合并记录整理为 TXT、JSON、Markdown、PNG、文件或纯文字转发，并支持定型文、文件名和发送方式设置；提供 getForwardMsg 或标准展开节点的适配器均可按能力使用。
